keyPoints: RSI가 과매도 구간을 탈출하여 50.9로 상승했으나, 여전히 중립권에 머물러 강세 전환 신호로 보기에는 이르다.

5일 저가($0.15)와 20일 저가($0.15)가 동일하게 유지되며, 스윙 지지선($0.16)과도 근접하여 횡보 구간이 지속되고 있다.
keyPointsEn: RSI has exited oversold territory and risen to 50.9, but remains in the neutral zone, making it too early to confirm a strong bullish reversal.
The MACD histogram remains at 0.0002, unchanged from 5 days ago, indicating slowing improvement and a low probability of a trend reversal.
The 5-day low ($0.15) and 20-day low ($0.15) are identical, holding near the swing support level ($0.16), suggesting a continued sideways consolidation.
